entities.name: UniProt Q6MIK8 dephospho-CoA kinase
observations: Exact sequence match to the supplied 201-aa sequence; reviewed Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus protein.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent phosphorylation of 3'-dephospho-CoA to CoA (EC 2.7.1.24; Rhea RHEA:18245).
Annotated cytoplasmic enzyme in the final step of coenzyme A biosynthesis.
